model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата представя групирана стълбовидна диаграма, която илюстрира точността (Accuracy) на шест различни метода върху три бенчмарка. Хоризонталната ос съдържа три категории — Mathverse, MMLU и Physics — подредени отляво надясно в този ред. Вертикалната ос е етикетирана като „Accuracy (%)" и обхваща диапазон приблизително от 52% до 62%, със стъпка от 2 процентни пункта, при линейна скала. За всяка категория са групирани по шест стълба, съответстващи на шестте метода, обозначени в легендата в горната част на диаграмата: DAPO+Self-reflection (плътен син), DAPO (син с диагонални щрихи), SRPO (плътен оранжев), GRPO (оранжев с диагонални щрихи), PPO+Self-reflection (плътен зелен) и PPO (зелен с диагонални щрихи). В групата Mathverse стойностите варират приблизително от около 53% до малко над 56%, като най-високият стълб принадлежи на DAPO+Self-reflection с около 56%, а най-ниските стълби са около 53%. В групата MMLU стойностите се разпростират приблизително от около 55% до около 57%, като DAPO+Self-reflection отново показва стойност около 57%, а останалите методи са в диапазона от приблизително 55.5% до 57%. В групата Physics стойностите са най-високи в сравнение с другите две категории, като варират приблизително от около 57% до малко над 60.5%, където DAPO+Self-reflection достига приблизително 57.5%, SRPO — около 58%, а PPO показва стойност около 59%. Стълбите в рамките на всяка група са подредени последователно в реда, в който методите са изброени в легендата. Визуалното разграничение между методите е постигнато чрез комбинация от цвят (син, оранжев, зелен) и текстура (плътно запълване за вариантите със Self-reflection и SRPO, диагонални щрихи за DAPO, GRPO и PPO).
model_annotations.Chinese: This grouped bar chart displays the accuracy (in percentage) of six different methods—DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO—across three benchmark categories. The horizontal axis contains the category labels, arranged in the order Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics, while the vertical axis represents Accuracy (%) on a linear scale ranging from approximately 52% to 62%, with gridlines appearing at intervals of 2 percentage points. For each benchmark category, six bars are grouped side by side in a consistent left-to-right order corresponding to the six methods listed in the legend. DAPO+Self-reflection is shown in solid blue, DAPO in blue with diagonal hatching, SRPO in solid orange, GRPO in orange with diagonal hatching, PPO+Self-reflection in solid dark green, and PPO in green with diagonal hatching. In the Mathverse group, the bars range from approximately 53.1% (DAPO+Self-reflection) to about 56.1% (DAPO), with SRPO near 55.8%, GRPO near 53.5%, PPO+Self-reflection near 53.3%, and PPO near 54.5%. In the MMLU group, values range from approximately 54.8% (PPO+Self-reflection) to about 57.1% (SRPO), with DAPO+Self-reflection near 55.8%, DAPO near 56.9%, GRPO near 56.2%, and PPO near 56.2%. In the Physics group, the bars span a wider range, from approximately 56.8% (GRPO) to about 60.5% (SRPO), with DAPO+Self-reflection near 57.5%, DAPO near 58.1%, PPO+Self-reflection near 60.5%, and PPO near 59.1%. The bars within each group do not appear to follow a consistent ascending or descending order across all benchmarks. The hatched patterns visually distinguish the base methods (DAPO, GRPO, PPO) from their solid-colored counterparts that include the Self-reflection variant or represent SRPO, aiding in visual comparison within each group.
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy (in percentage) of six different methods—DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO—across three benchmark categories. The horizontal axis contains three categorical groups: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics, arranged from left to right. The vertical axis represents Accuracy (%), with a linear scale ranging from approximately 52% to 62%, with tick marks at intervals of 2 percentage points. Within each benchmark group, six bars are displayed side by side, each corresponding to one method. DAPO+Self-reflection is shown in solid blue, DAPO in blue with diagonal hatching, SRPO in solid orange, GRPO in orange with diagonal hatching, PPO+Self-reflection in solid dark green, and PPO in green with diagonal hatching. For the Mathverse group, the bars show approximate values of 53.1% (DAPO+Self-reflection), 56.1% (DAPO), 53.5% (SRPO), 55.8% (GRPO), 53.3% (PPO+Self-reflection), and 54.5% (PPO). For the MMLU group, the approximate values are 55.8% (DAPO+Self-reflection), 57.0% (DAPO), 55.8% (SRPO), 57.2% (GRPO), 54.8% (PPO+Self-reflection), and 56.2% (PPO). For the Physics group, the approximate values are 57.5% (DAPO+Self-reflection), 58.1% (DAPO), 58.1% (SRPO), 60.5% (GRPO), 56.8% (PPO+Self-reflection), and 59.1% (PPO). The tallest bar across the entire chart is GRPO on the Physics benchmark at approximately 60.5%, while the shortest bar is DAPO+Self-reflection on Mathverse at approximately 53.1%. The bars within each group are not sorted by height but rather follow a consistent left-to-right ordering of the six methods across all three benchmarks. No bars appear to be visually emphasized beyond the color and hatching distinctions used to differentiate the methods.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt die Genauigkeit (Accuracy) in Prozent für sechs verschiedene Methoden über drei Benchmark-Kategorien hinweg. Die horizontale Achse enthält die drei Kategorien „Mathverse", „MMLU" und „Physics", während die vertikale Achse die Genauigkeit in Prozent darstellt, mit einer linearen Skala, die von etwa 52 % bis 62 % reicht und in Schritten von 2 Prozentpunkten beschriftet ist. Für jede Kategorie sind sechs gruppierte Balken nebeneinander angeordnet, die jeweils eine der sechs Methoden repräsentieren: „DAPO+Self-reflection" (ausgefülltes Blau), „DAPO" (blau mit diagonaler Schraffur), „SRPO" (ausgefülltes Orange), „GRPO" (orange mit diagonaler Schraffur), „PPO+Self-reflection" (ausgefülltes Dunkelgrün) und „PPO" (grün mit diagonaler Schraffur), wie in der Legende oben im Diagramm angegeben. In der Kategorie „Mathverse" erreichen die Balken Werte von etwa 53,1 % (DAPO+Self-reflection) bis etwa 56,1 % (DAPO), wobei SRPO bei circa 55,8 %, GRPO bei circa 53,5 %, PPO+Self-reflection bei circa 53,3 % und PPO bei circa 54,5 % liegen. In der Kategorie „MMLU" liegen die Werte zwischen etwa 55,8 % (DAPO) und circa 57,2 % (SRPO), mit DAPO+Self-reflection bei circa 55,8 %, GRPO bei circa 56,2 %, PPO+Self-reflection bei circa 54,8 % und PPO bei circa 56,2 %. In der Kategorie „Physics" zeigen die Balken die höchsten Werte insgesamt, wobei DAPO bei circa 60,5 % den höchsten Wert erreicht, gefolgt von SRPO bei circa 58,1 %, DAPO+Self-reflection bei circa 57,5 %, PPO bei circa 59,1 %, PPO+Self-reflection bei circa 56,8 % und GRPO bei circa 56,2 %. Die Balken sind innerhalb jeder Gruppe in der Reihenfolge der Legende von links nach rechts angeordnet, und die visuelle Unterscheidung zwischen den Methoden erfolgt sowohl durch Farbe als auch durch Schraffurmuster, wobei die Varianten mit „Self-reflection" jeweils als ausgefüllte Balken und die Basisvarianten als schraffierte Balken dargestellt sind.
